motion.scope: Original capture timestamps, decoded frame hashes, browser callbacks, overview/consecutive contact sheets and selected native frames are separate evidence. No interpolation, CFR padding, global animation acceptance or every-frame native inspection claimed.

remaining_limits: Visual review is bounded to the listed samples and native frames, not every frame, every theme or every possible layout.

Original recordings retain Chromium fullscreen/download hints and a pale transient overlay near startup; they were not edited away. Informational toasts also briefly cover parts of the upper transcript during rapid actions.
Encoded timestamps, identical-frame hashes and browser callbacks are not actual-paint instrumentation. Static repeated frames are not by themselves evidence of dropped animation.
Ordinary file and loopback HTTP navigation was blocked before application load by this environment; unrestricted-browser navigation remains unproved.
Installer execution was tested on Linux. Native Windows/macOS installation and cross-host/restart durability remain unproved.
The order-export adapter recognizes a bounded task grammar; unrelated objectives save but block old work rather than pretending general model execution.
Deep Plan admission/binding reuses existing bundle and To-Do list; execution without an adapter blocks instead of producing fake completion.
Branch/restore evidence is in-memory identity and continuation safety, not native crash recovery, cross-host durability or V1 migration.
A material bound-objective conflict exposes Revise and stops mutation; automatic revised-Plan/Goal reconciliation is not claimed.
Some original GREPLAY/PGOAL/APR packet wording remains unavailable; current-owner behavior and source-ID inventory are not exhaustive original-clause acceptance.
